authorized_by: Root integration owner explicitly authorized preparation of this configuration-only experiment and this exact phase order after independently reviewed V9 A closure. No API request is authorized by this plan.
reason: Evaluate the controlled process-local reasoning-effort change from medium to max for all Luna roles, while retaining exactly the V9 application source, prompts, executor, output cap and other configuration. Q05 failed and Q06 passed strict review in V9 A. Repeat both under one new identity before opening the remaining fifteen cases. This disclosed selection and repeated-question trial is development evidence, not an unseen or representative holdout. No improvement from max is assumed.

dispatch_gate.phase_a: Fresh source/executor/configuration freeze, exact unchanged input bindings, a masked process-local max configuration delta, offline provider-count and generation/role propagation proof, relevant existing configuration checks and explicit root A-only execution GO must exist before any V10 model request. Reuse the V9 full 560-pass and scoped 40+48-pass evidence only after all covered source/test identities are verified unchanged; do not represent reused tests as fresh reruns.
dispatch_gate.phase_b: Both Q05 and Q06 must have independent strict_pass=true and application_complete=true, then root gives a fresh phase-B dispatch GO.
dispatch_gate.phase_a_failure: Preserve each failed or incomplete case, actual turn, retry and observed usage. A strict/application failure blocks phase B and leaves all fifteen B cases unrun. Complete the remaining planned phase-A case under the same identity unless a provider, runtime, budget or owner stop applies; a failed case is never silently replayed.
dispatch_gate.source_change_after_phase_a: Any application, prompt, executor or configuration change requires a new candidate revision. Different source/configuration identities cannot be combined into final_v10.
dispatch_gate.interruption: Preserve actual attempts and planned/observed/unrun turns. An undispatched turn is not an actual run. Follow existing provider, central budget and owner stops.

identity_requirements: Both phases must bind the same frozen application source inventory, executor, protocol, model, max reasoning effort and evaluation configuration.

Each selected input object must equal the unchanged frozen protocol input exactly. No expected answer, evaluator label, rubric, supplementary answer key or evaluation-specific reference material is added to the model input. The ordinary application case brief, source and KPI definitions remain legitimate context.
Use fresh isolated sessions per case; keep the Q09 session across its two turns. Retain isolated Operations state and source-status restoration before each case.

Request and verify only gpt-6-luna with max effort for every ordinary Luna role through the process-local OPENAI_REASONING_EFFORT override. Preserve medium in the normal UI and .env files. Keep the original case modes, filters, prompts and context conditions, local canonical tools, hosted file search disabled, async tools disabled and native multi-agent disabled for this fixed evaluation.
Continue the existing central USD 5 per-run and USD 10 development ledger. Preserve all old holds; do not reset, fork or create another budget. Only luna_engine_sol dispatches paid model requests.

The generic run_final.py executor remains byte-identical to V9; any actual necessity for an executor or source edit invalidates this configuration-only comparison and requires an explicitly disclosed new revision before dispatch.

reporting.phase_a_only: Report two attempted cases and two planned turns with actual observed counts. A-only results are not a completed seventeen-case suite. Q01 original-baseline comparison is absent from phase A.
reporting.complete_candidate: A complete V10 result requires seventeen reviewed cases, eighteen observed planned turns across both phases and matching source/executor/configuration identities; otherwise list all unrun and incomplete cases.
reporting.metrics: Keep independent strict task success, application completion and end-to-end completion separate. Count Q09 once as a case and every actual distinct turn once in telemetry. Preserve every earlier revision rather than pooling quality rates.
reporting.comparison_limit: These are disclosed development regressions on reused questions. Only Q01 has an observed original baseline. No general model improvement or unseen-question benchmark claim is supported.
reporting.semantic_grading: Apply the unchanged original criteria by semantic meaning across actual delivered chat and selected files. Hidden receipts do not satisfy reported answer coverage. Table-tool usage, table format and exact keywords are not required unless the actual task requires them; optional reported numbers must be correct for their displayed population/labels.
reporting.configuration_comparison: The intended experimental delta is medium to max reasoning effort for all Luna roles via process-local override. Source, prompts, model, output cap 12000, QA retries 2, service tier, tools, existing file-search override and central budgets remain unchanged. Different actual response counts, trajectories, QA repairs and usage are observed outcomes and must be retained. A two-case adaptive development trial cannot establish general reasoning-effort superiority.

source_identity_binding: Pending a not-yet-dispatched final_v10 freeze that verifies the complete V9 source/test/frontend/workbook identities remain unchanged and binds the process-local max configuration and exact inputs. The prospective plan alone authorizes no request; its SHA-256 must appear in the V10 freeze and manifests.

Final V9 reviewer-closure bindings will be added only to the separate V10 freeze after closure, without rewriting this pre-outcome plan.
